question: Who is the Union Minister of Civil Aviation in Government of India? (As of March, 2024).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotiraditya M. Scindia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyotiraditya M. Scindia** is the current Union Minister of Civil Aviation in Government of India as of March, 2024.
 
• He assumed office on **July 7, 2021**, succeeding Hardeep Singh Puri.
 
• As the Union Minister of Civil Aviation, he is responsible for formulating national policies and programs for the development and regulation of the Civil Aviation sector in India.
 
• He plays a crucial role in ensuring the safety, security, and growth of the aviation industry, which includes airlines, airports, and related services.
 
• Under his leadership, several initiatives have been undertaken to enhance the infrastructure and operational efficiency of the aviation sector in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotiraditya M. Scindia** is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and represents the state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• He has also served as a Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha and has held various other significant positions in the government.
 
• The Ministry of Civil Aviation oversees the functioning of the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS), and the Airports Authority of India (AAI).
 
• Efforts are being made to improve regional connectivity through the UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik) scheme, which aims to make air travel affordable and widespread.
 
• Jyotiraditya M. Scindia has been actively involved in promoting sustainable practices and technological advancements in the aviation sector.
